bannerText: Muse X Poster: bài đã điền sẵn (đã bỏ tag Binance). Bấm Post trên X để đăng, rồi báo Muse là xong.
note: Muse X Poster v1.3: pick the FOCUSED editor first (X focuses the modal editor when the dialog opens; v1.2 picked the visible inline editor instead, so text went to the wrong composer while the image went to the modal). Fill replaces leftover content (selectAll before insertText) and fails the job if the filled text still does not match instead of warning and proceeding.
